curriculumFinding: For Fall 2026 entrants, the adopted 2026–2027 regulations establish ten compulsory 6 EC first-year courses and at least 30 EC open study in the first semester of Year 3. The curriculum revision removes the old BMW/DGZ/KW specialisations. Its Year 2 has six compulsory courses and four choice slots, including Genomics versus Qualitative Research and Anatomy/Physiology 2 versus System Transformation. It describes biomedical or societal research in Year 3, preparatory methods for the societal project and a final Science Communication course, but supplies no applicable future component-credit table. Old 18/24 EC thesis weights and outgoing specialisation tables cannot be imported. Lab safety is required before the Biochemistry practical; its grade also requires the Dutch diagnostic pass or completed refresher. Toxicology/Epidemiology requires completion of Year-1 study/career guidance. These noncredit conditions are separate from 180 EC. BSA normally requires 42 first-year EC. Attendance rules follow course manuals. Open study needs approval except stated minor exemptions, nonoverlap, at least 12 EC level 300 and at most 6 EC level 100; subjects in the degree field must be level 300. Listed minors remain conditional on entrance requirements and nonoverlap. Optional honours are excluded.
